ModMetaData.name: The Secret of Anima - Cairns and Totems
ModMetaData.author: Nuff
ModMetaData.description: A mod in The Secret of Anima, a series of mods focused on providing an alternate progression path for your colony. Instead of technology, embrace the power of the Anima tree. - Anima Cairns are buildings that link to Anima trees and provide benefits to colonists who meditate at the linked tree. - Anima Totems are buildings that link to Anima trees and provide map- or world-wide effects.
